name: Gorilla Gravity
summary: Gorilla Gravity is a game where you be a monkey and play in space with your friends! You jump really high 'cause there’s low gravity and it feels like flying! There’s fun games like parkour where you climb and jump on stuff, and a speeding wall that tries to smush you so you gotta run fast! And there's a skate park where you zoom around and do silly flips! It’s super fun and you can go wheeee everywhere!
